name: job-search-assistant
description: JobSearchAssistant: finds job leads in job-alert email and on company career sites you choose, logs them to a Google Sheet tracker with a quick Tier 1 fit score, scores the leads you tick in the tracker against the full resume with a deterministic rubric and a full gap report, rescores as you update the resume, and builds tailored resumes on request in the user's own resume style.
